statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), let R count actual induced rook-nine vertex sets once and put d_T=6-r_T for each actual triangle. Suppose R=226, every d_T belongs to {0,1,2,3}, exactly two actual triangles have deficiency three, and exactly two have deficiency two. Then the two deficiency-three triangles are disjoint.
